method_statistics.test_family: Paired binary strict model-action error treated vs same-scene neutral under frozen policy, with old baseline correctness reported as independent conditioning layer
method_statistics.exact_p_formula: If k independently matched discordant units all favor treatment causing error and zero the other way, exact two-sided McNemar/sign p = 2*(1/2)^k (capped 1).
caveats: Exact McNemar assumes appropriately independent matched units, and source-group correlation invalidates treating all scenes as independent test units.
No observed treatment/neutral pairs have been run so these are design simulations, NOT actual P values.

Even 0/12 strict errors would have about 22.1% one-sided 95% upper limit only IF independent units; with 3 independent groups, analogous 0/3 limit is 63.16% under simplified independent group-level Bernoulli model.
No G0 source-pair survivor count exists and source groups may heavily overlap; multi-axes testing requires alpha/multiple-testing plan or transparent exploratory labeling.
Clean-correct baseline condition is an estimand restriction, not an unbiased overall model risk measure; report unconditional errors and conditional clean-to-wrong separately.
